Summer Company Program for Young Entrepreneurs

 


Provides training, mentoring and grants up to $3,000 to Ontario students, between the ages of 15 and 29, who wish to start a full-time business over the summer.​

OSBAC programs and services are delivered by the Brampton Entrepreneur Centre and are funded in partnership with the Government of Ontario.​

​

Thank you to all who applied in 2026! Applications are now closed.

We look forward to launching the 2027 Summer Company Program in January of next year. Please subscribe to our newsletter and follow us on social media for updates.


Please carefully review the three required steps below:

Step 1: Complete the Eligibility Pre-Screening

You must complete the eligibility questions to determine program eligibility. If you do not pass the pre-screening, you will be unable to create an application in the system.

Students applying must have a Social Insurance Number (SIN)

Step 2: Application Form

The Summer Company application is where we gather important information about you and your business idea to determine your eligibility and learn more about your plans for the summer.

Step 3: Complete Your Business Plan & Cash Flow & Upload

You are required to build your business plan and cash flow projections using the templates provided in application.

We will not accept applications that use any business plan or cash flow template other than the ones provided.

Summer Company Program Guidelines

Detailed guidelines on how to apply for money to start your own student business this summer.

Program Information

Summer Company is a program of the government of Ontario that helps young people between 15 and 29 years old start and run their own summer business by providing funding, advice and services. The Brampton Entrepreneur Centre delivers Summer Company for Brampton/Caledon students.

If you're accepted into the program, you'll receive:

  • an award of up to $3,000
    • a first payment of up to $1,500 for start-up costs
    • a second payment of up to $1,500 once you've successfully completed the program
  • hands-on coaching
  • mentoring from business leaders in your community and from your program provider

You also get to keep any profits generated through the operation of your business.
